# larm_status_page (Resource)

Manages a Larm status page and its full structure (groups, components, monitor links) as one resource. The `components` attribute is the ordered tree shown on the page. Top-level entries are either groups (which contain components) or ungrouped components; they interleave in the order written.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "larm_monitor" "api" {
  name       = "API"
  check_type = "http"
  config = jsonencode({
    url                   = "https://api.example.com/health"
    method                = "GET"
    expected_status_codes = [200]
  })
}

resource "larm_monitor" "db" {
  name       = "Database"
  check_type = "http"
  config = jsonencode({
    url                   = "https://db.example.com/health"
    method                = "GET"
    expected_status_codes = [200]
  })
}

resource "larm_status_page" "acme" {
  name          = "Acme Status"
  slug          = "acme"
  description   = "Live status of Acme services."
  primary_color = "#E02424"

  components = [
    {
      type = "group"
      name = "Core Services"
      components = [
        {
          name = "API"
          monitors = [
            {
              monitor_id  = larm_monitor.api.id
              down_status = "major_outage"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          name = "Database"
          monitors = [
            {
              monitor_id = larm_monitor.db.id
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      type        = "component"
      name        = "Email"
      description = "Transactional email delivery."
    },
    {
      type = "group"
      name = "Web"
      components = [
        { name = "Dashboard" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `slug` (String) URL slug. Used in the page's public URL (`<slug>.status.larm.dev`). Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, 3-63 chars, starting and ending with a letter or number. Changing the slug rewrites the public URL.

### Optional

- `components` (Attributes List) Ordered tree of groups and ungrouped components. List order is display order on the page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components))
- `description` (String) Optional description displayed on the page.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the page is published. Defaults to `true`.
- `primary_color` (String) Brand color as a hex string (`#RRGGBB`).
- `subscribers_enabled` (Boolean) Whether email subscribers can sign up to the page. Defaults to `false`.
- `theme` (String) Page theme. One of `light`, `dark`, `system`.

### Read-Only

- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain configured for the page, if any. Manage via the dashboard.
- `domain_status` (String) Status of the custom domain provisioning, if any.
- `id` (String) Status page ID.
- `inserted_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `logo_dark_url` (String) URL of the logo shown on dark backgrounds. Manage via the dashboard.
- `logo_light_url` (String) URL of the logo shown on light backgrounds. Manage via the dashboard.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `url` (String) Computed public URL of the page.

<a id="nestedatt--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components`

Required:

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `type` (String) Entry kind. One of `group`, `component`.

Optional:

- `components` (Attributes List) Components inside this group (in display order). Only valid when `type = "group"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components--components))
- `description` (String) Component description. Only meaningful when `type = "component"`.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) Monitors linked to this component. Only valid when `type = "component"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components--monitors))

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Entry ID (computed).

<a id="nestedatt--components--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components.components`

Required:

- `name` (String) Display name.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Component description.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) Monitors linked to this component. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components--components--monitors))

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--components--components--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components.components.monitors`

Required:

- `monitor_id` (String) Monitor ID to link.

Optional:

- `down_status` (String) Status to display when this monitor is down. One of `degraded_performance`, `partial_outage`, `major_outage`. Defaults to `major_outage`.



<a id="nestedatt--components--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components.monitors`

Required:

- `monitor_id` (String) Monitor ID to link.

Optional:

- `down_status` (String) Status to display when this monitor is down. One of `degraded_performance`, `partial_outage`, `major_outage`. Defaults to `major_outage`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import larm_status_page.acme 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
